helpStep1: Turn on Tools › Override macOS Proxy, or set a device's HTTP proxy to {address}. Apps that ignore the system proxy can use SOCKS5 (Settings › Proxy).
helpStep2: Certificate › Install Certificate on this Mac. For phones, open http://proxy.go on the device while it uses ProxyGo, then trust the profile.
helpStep3: Encrypted tunnels show a lock. Choose Enable only this domain in the response pane, or add domains in Tools › SSL Proxying List.
helpStep4: Repeat (⌘R) and Compose (⌘E) requests; pause them with Breakpoints; serve local files with Map Local; send them elsewhere with Map Remote; change them with Scripts; slow them down with Network Conditions; block them with the Block List; and resolve hosts with DNS Spoofing.
helpStep5: Settings › Automation serves MCP to AI assistants and installs proxygo-cli, which records, exports and adds rules from a terminal. Certificate › Automatic Setup opens a terminal, a browser or an Electron app already going through ProxyGo.
